prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Check photo lighting and clarity before continuing to pet adoption."]
1: ["Sign In & Restore Your Pets", "Cloud Pet Saver Active", "Signing in automatically restores previously adopted pets."]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Render", "Rendering desktop overlays...", "Desktop Engine: Ready"]
3: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is active! Check the next screen for full desktop controls and hotkeys."]
4: ["Your adoption certificate is officially signed! Preparing your desktop pet now.", "Official Pet Adoption Approved!"]
5: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Choose whether to build a custom pet companion or adopt a ready-made preset friend."]
6: ["Stuck loading? Click below to retry account connection or launch offline preview.", "Retry Connection"]
7: ["Select Pet Personality: Playful, Calm, or Curious"]
8: ["Right-click pet: Open Settings | Double-click: Play | Drag: Move around screen"]
9: ["Estimated generation time: 45 seconds"]

verdicts.problem: Suggests getting around the required account connection/sign-in step via offline preview
